title: Pi Mention Skill settings
description: Settings for skill mentions and slash-skill visibility.

$schema.description: JSON Schema used by editors for this settings file.

trigger.description: One or more non-whitespace, non-slash characters that start a skill mention.

hideSlashSkills.description: Hide skill commands from slash-command completion.

completionSuffix.description: Text inserted after a completed skill mention.

strategy.description: Ordering used before any skill query text is entered.

pinned.description: Skill names placed first, in this order, before the configured strategy.

projectSkillsFirst.description: Place project-local skills before user and temporary skills in initial suggestions.

initialSuggestions.description: Controls the entries shown immediately after the trigger.
